purpose: Teach: 異色/利得/顔写真/開閉/管制/政局/ボーダー/県外

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 異色のキャリアの方を採用しましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with hiring someone from an unconventional background.
lines.style: Clear, businesslike delivery. Crisp onset. Matter-of-fact tone without harshness. Decisive but not dismissive. A suggestion that's already half-decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。短期利得に走らない方針です
lines.en: Yes. That's the policy—no chasing short-term gains.
lines.style: Steady agreement. Light affirmation on 'Yes.' Slight pause before the principle, as if anchoring to something larger than the moment. Measured cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員証の顔写真撮影日を決めましょう
lines.en: Let's set a date for the employee ID photos.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-moving. Direct address without preamble. Efficient tone—one task checked off, onto the next. Slight lift at the end, opening to Kenji's input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫扉の開閉ログを取ります
lines.en: Yes. We'll start logging the warehouse door access.
lines.style: Confirmatory and competent. Light emphasis on the action verb. No hesitation—he's already moving. Practical, grounded tone. Small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 管制塔との連携訓練を実施しましょう
lines.en: Let's run a coordination drill with the control tower.
lines.style: Clear directive, slightly elevated in importance. Purposeful tempo. The kind of instruction that signals preparation and care. Open, expectant ending.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。政局のニュースを朝礼で共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll share the policy briefing at tomorrow's morning meeting.
lines.style: Prompt, professional agreement. Quick intake of breath before delivering the plan. No elaboration—he knows what needs doing. Steady, competent close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ボーダー柄の新商品を企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's develop a new product line with a border-pattern design.
lines.style: Forward-thinking, slightly energized. Clean attack on the opening. Conversational but structured—pitching an idea with confidence. Encouraging finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。県外出張の予算を確保します
lines.en: Yes. I'll secure the budget for out-of-prefecture travel.
lines.style: Conclusive, efficient. Firm agreement on 'Yes.' Slight downward inflection—this is settled. Professional closing energy. The sense of wrapping up cleanly.
